S10@1.prompt: When folded into a cube, which two letters end up on opposite faces?
S10@1.explanation: Every face of a cube has exactly one opposite, and opposite faces never share an edge. Folding the net shows that B & C are opposite faces. The three pairs of opposite faces are A & E, B & C and D & F; every other pair meets along an edge.
